messages:
emily_pm: Quick proposal 1: 'micro-staggered opt-in' rollout for the regional fallback feature. Aim: stress the fallback paths with minimal blast radius and get quality signals from real traffic + tenant opt-in behavior. Posting the condensed plan for review.

raj_eng: quick bullets pls 1

emily_pm: sure:
- cohort size: start with 0.5% of global traffic as the canary cohort (very small)
- sequence: day0 us-east-1 only, day1 add us-west-2, day3 eu-west-1 (if stable)
- opt-in model: default eligible true, tenants may be added to tenant_exempt list or explicitly opt-in to beta via support ticket
- experiment inside cohort: split 50/50 routing strategy A (fallback) vs B (no fallback) to measure quality/cost delta
- duration: each region baseline 24h; extend to 72h if metrics plateau

mia_sre: whats the kill-switch and automation rules?

emily_pm: kill-switch: flag name feature.fallback.micro_optin (server-side), plus shiproom global abort button. Automation: 3 consecutive 5m windows breaching threshold triggers auto-global-failover to current behavior (not full rollback) 1 (see gates). Manual immediate rollback still available.

devex_jordan: SDK/console changes? need names and route-level overrides.

emily_pm: SDK flag: feature.fallback.micro_optin, route override key: fallback_override, tenant flag: fallback.tenant_holdout. Console: add new tile under "Experiments -> Micro Opt-in" showing cohort size, region slices, and AB split.

raj_eng: gates in observability form so SRE can create monitors?

emily_pm: gating metrics:
- p50_latency_delta_ms: 120
- request_error_rate_pct: 0.4
- fallback_success_rate_pct: 99
- small sample-quality check: eval-set "regional-fallback-mini" (auto-run 1k prompts per region/day)
- cost-per-token-delta_pct: +10% (soft)

mia_sre: prefer a 3-strike on p50 or error_rate before auto action; also recommend hysteresis window of 15m after any action to avoid immediate flip-flop. we should log decision reasons.

emily_pm: agree. 3-strike breaching (5m windows) + 15m cooldown. Decision logs: record in rollout-audit stream with tags.

devex_jordan: telemetry needs: add fallback_reason enum, route_id, and trace link; sample 0.2% full request payloads to private S3 bucket for offline evaluation. Also add a compact metric for fallback_count by tenant.

raj_eng: about AB: what metrics for comparing A vs B? i want token_cost, median_latency, and a quality pass/fail from the tiny eval set. also retention signals for small subset of logged-in users.

emily_pm: yes exactly: token_cost_per_request, p50 latency, quality_pass_rate. keep AB results internal and attach to the rollout ticket.

infra-bot: ci: pipeline queued: pipelines/rollouts/micro_optin/1777777000 by @emily_pm. link: https://ci.internal/redwood/rollouts/1777777000

mia_sre: runbook snippet pls. what commands to flip off the flag and to force route-level fallback?

emily_pm: runbook (short):
1) emergency stop: curl -X POST https://ops.internal/flags/feature.fallback.micro_optin/deactivate -H "Auth: x"
2) force route fallback: POST /admin/routes/{route}/override body {"fallback": "off"}
3) collect traces: /admin/collect-traces?since=now-1h&tag=rollback
4) postmortem: create incident ticket with tags rollout/micro_optin and assign SRE/ENG leads

raj_eng: we should also stage synthetic load tests hitting fallback path pre-rollout: run 10m synthetic load per region to validate perf before opening cohort.

emily_pm: good call. devex please run quick synthetic scripts and add to preflight checklist.

devex_jordan: will do. adding preflight: infra smoke, synthetic fallback perf, sanity eval-run, and console flag visibility confirmation.

mia_sre: one more: tenant communication. if a customer is in tenant_exempt, ensure their metrics are excluded from AB analysis; ops needs a CSV export of exempt tenants.

emily_pm: will add that to shiproom ticket: exempt-tenants.csv export and clear labeling.

raj_eng: sounds good from eng. timeline?

emily_pm: target open-canary this Friday 12:00 UTC pending thumbs. if any blocker call it out now.

devex_jordan: +1 for rollout readiness (console + SDK patches merged).

mia_sre: +1 for SRE automation and dashboards. I'll post dashboard links once ready.

emily_pm: thanks everyone. i'll create the shiproom run ticket with the full annotated rollout table (region windows, cohort sizes, owners, and rollback commands). ping here for any last-minute changes. :white_check_mark:
